column4: Magic Painter picture saved as .PIC without the MGP rainbow-flag byte (screen at offset 5). RECOIL rejects .PIC of this size. Rewritten as an MGP (flag 04 inserted, last byte dropped), recoil2png renders identical pixels except the dropped last byte; the picture is the coherent Crumble's Crisis title screen.

Daisy-Dot III font ('3' 0x9B), parsed exactly to the 3-byte trailer per the monobit Daisy-Dot III reader (MIT). RECOIL only reads Daisy-Dot II. Reviewed render: legible Art Deco alphabet, tall capitals spanning both 16-dot bands. Sheet layout (32-dot cells) is our extension of RECOIL's DD II sheet.

Daisy-Dot III font ('3' 0x9B), parsed exactly to the 3-byte trailer per the monobit Daisy-Dot III reader (MIT). RECOIL only reads Daisy-Dot II. Reviewed render: legible sans-serif alphabet with descenders (g, p, q, y) in the second 16-dot band.
